title: Insurance Claim Repairs Total-Loss Determinations — Balances and Insurer Charges
content:
**Standing statement.** A total loss on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order is the insurer's determination, recorded as received; the desk never declares or disputes one.

## On the total-loss date

- Every deductible and betterment charge is credited to the customer with the reason "total-loss release"; the insurer applies the deductible in its own settlement.
- One total-loss reversal adjustment, naming the original-estimate approval, brings the insurer balance on the repair approvals to zero; none posts when no approval was booked.

## Total-loss charges billed to the insurer

The insurer is then billed a total-loss charges approval made up of:

1. **Disassembly** — the class's total-loss teardown hours at the class's withdrawal labor rate, where a teardown was done; and
2. **Storage** — the class's total-loss storage daily rate, lowered to the storage rate cap of the insurer's active Insurer Program Agreements agreement when that cap is lower, for every calendar day the vehicle stays after the class's total-loss removal free days, counted from the total-loss date as day zero.

| Agreement storage rate cap compared with the class rate | Daily rate billed |
|---|---|
| lower than the class rate | the cap |
| equal to or higher than the class rate, or no cap | the class rate |

## The customer

Customer-pay additions already performed stay due from the customer. The customer may collect personal belongings, but release of the vehicle itself is arranged with the insurer.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A class with 4.0 total-loss teardown hours, a withdrawal labor rate of USD 62.00, 3 removal free days and a total-loss storage rate of USD 65.00 per day; the insurer's agreement caps storage at USD 60.00; teardown done; the vehicle stays 3 calendar days beyond the free days (days 1 to 3 after the total-loss date being free).

- Disassembly: 4.0 hours at USD 62.00, USD 248.00.
- Storage: the cap of USD 60.00 is lower than USD 65.00, so 3 days at USD 60.00, USD 180.00.
- Total-loss charges approval: USD 428.00.
